row.notes: New in 2026-09. ShareASale.com redirects to Awin ('ShareASale is now part of Awin'; new customers launch directly on Awin), so the row covers the Awin advertiser platform. Plans: Access $49/month + 3.5% tracking fee (3-month minimum), Accelerate from $99/month + 2.5%, Advanced custom; all list unlimited team members, so per-user fields are null and prices are monthly as listed. Users are invited and removed manually with six permission levels (Owner to Restricted Viewer); sign-in uses password plus Two-Step Verification. No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM, JIT or user-management API is documented: the Awin API (Accelerate and Advanced) covers reporting, transactions and promotions, and its only user endpoint lists the caller's accounts. Okta's 'Awin' OIN app is SWA (password vaulting) only.

user_api.notes: The Awin API (OAuth2 bearer user token, https://api.awin.com) is available to advertisers on Accelerate and Advanced only and covers reporting, transactions, promotions and program data; the 'For Users' section holds only Get Accounts. No endpoint to invite, change or remove account users is documented, so user_api_available is left null.
